name: Mount Pleasant / Charleston KOA Holiday
note: KOA Holiday at 3157 N Highway 17, Mount Pleasant; full-hookup and water/electric RV sites, pull-throughs. RV sites $84.99-329.99 a night before tax for a mid-May 2027 weeknight on KOA's booking form. RV Life 4.5*, $$$$. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: KOA booking form (koa.com/campgrounds/mount-pleasant-charleston/reserve/) quoted 2027-05-18, 1 night, 23-ft motorhome: RV site types $84.99-329.99 before tax (read 2026-10-19); RV Life 4.5* over 513 reviews, 132 sites; within 40 km of a gateway (Charleston SC (18 km), gateways.py), so the price gate is lifted
wf: KOA's booking form names 'Lakefront' and 'Lakeside' types, consistent: satellite (Esri, sat.py) read 2026-10-19: the park fills a wooded point into a ~15 ha lake; the west loop's outer row backs onto the bank at ~10-20 m across open ground, the campground's own frontage; other rows inland; lakefront (west row)
